title: AWS Software Discovery Via SSM Inventory
description: Detects use of AWS Systems Manager to enumerate installed software and inventory on cloud workloads, aligned to MITRE ATT&CK detection strategy DET0392 / AN1103 for Software Discovery. Use the UserAgent mutable element to distinguish automated/authorized console access from adversary scripting.
falsePositives: Inventory, patch compliance, and configuration-management tooling querying SSM.
